title: 第1章 要我卖房，镶钻了？
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
浪漫时光咖啡店。

    两女一男相对而坐。

    一个长相靓丽，身段曼妙，能打85分的女子，正在怒目而视。

    “李西海，你什么意思？”

    “媛媛要出国留学，要你卖房怎么了？”

    “你不过一个本科生而已，媛媛是研究生，跟你谈了两年，当初还是你追的媛媛。”

    “现在要你拿钱出来，不过是卖房而已，又不是要你命，你就这么舍不得？”

    袁娜是赵媛的闺蜜，也是名牌大学，985的研究生。

    不过，她没有捞到出国留学的机会，卡在成绩跟签证上，反倒是赵媛成功拿到了名额。

    心里一直嫉妒，很不平衡，不好对闺蜜发作，但可以对闺蜜的男朋友啊。

    李西海一言不发。

    赵媛微微低头，一副楚楚可怜的模样。

    这让袁娜更来劲了。

    “你作为男朋友，这不是应该的吗？”

    ““这两年来，你上班也攒了不少钱吧，就拿几千块钱，你也好意思？”

    袁娜的攻击性很足，冷言讥讽，完全看不起李西海。

    李西海掏出一支烟，在鼻子前嗅了嗅，要不是这咖啡店禁烟，他肯定是点上了。

    “你装什么装，你说话啊。”

    “你要是不愿意，媛媛就只能跟你分手，你也配当媛媛的男朋友？”

    袁娜冷笑，正主都没表态，她反倒是帮忙做了决定。

    “呵！”

    李西海轻蔑一笑，淡淡道：“什么批，这么金贵，还要我卖房啊？”

    “镶钻了的吗？”

    啊？

    袁娜一愣，赵媛满是怒容。

    “你……你怎么说这种话。”赵媛终于开口了，羞怒交加。

    “那我要问问你，房子是我父母出的首付，贷款是我还的，你要我卖房就卖房。”

    李西海骂道：“尼玛比的，给你脸了是不是？”

    “你算什么东西，张口就要我卖房。”

    “就凭睡了你？”

    “你特码也不是处啊。”

    在闺蜜面前，被李西海这样辱骂，赵媛再也忍不住，拿起咖啡就朝李西海泼了上去。

    “人渣！”

    骂完，赵媛拎着包，怒气冲冲的离开。

    “畜生！”

    袁娜丢下这句话，也紧随其后。

    周围的顾客，见到这一幕，都在偷偷观察，低声议论。

    李西海摸了一把脸上的咖啡，手机叮咚一声响起。

    “分手吧。”
content_en:
Romantic time coffee shop.

    Two women and one man sit opposite each other.

    A woman with beautiful appearance, graceful figure and a score of 85 is glaring at her.

    "Li Xihai, what do you mean?"

    "Yuanyuan is going to study abroad. What's wrong with asking you to sell your house?"

    "You are just an undergraduate, and Yuanyuan is a graduate student. I have been dating you for two years, and it was you who pursued Yuanyuan in the first place."

    "Now I want you to take out the money, but it's just to sell the house, and it's not about your life. Are you so reluctant to part with it?"

    Yuan Na is Zhao Yuan's best friend and a graduate student at a prestigious university, 985.

    However, she did not get the opportunity to study abroad because she was stuck with her grades and visa. On the contrary, Zhao Yuan successfully got the place.

    I have always been jealous and very unbalanced. It is not easy to get angry with my best friend, but I can be angry with my best friend's boyfriend.

    Li Xihai said nothing.

    Zhao Yuan lowered her head slightly, looking pitiful.

    This made Yuan Na even more excited.

    "As a boyfriend, isn't this what you should do?"

    ""In the past two years, you have saved a lot of money from working, right? How do you feel embarrassed to just take a few thousand yuan? "

    Yuan Na was very aggressive, sarcastic and looked down on Li Xihai completely.

    Li Xihai took out a cigarette and sniffed it in front of his nose. If smoking hadn't been banned in this coffee shop, he would have lit it.

    "What are you pretending to be? You are talking. "

    "If you don't want to, Yuanyuan will have no choice but to break up with you. Are you worthy of being Yuanyuan's boyfriend? "

    Yuan Na sneered. The real owner didn't express his position, but she helped make the decision.

    "Ha! "

    Li Xihai smiled contemptuously and said lightly: "What kind of batch? It's so expensive and you still want me to sell my house? "

    "Diamond-encrusted? "

    Huh?

    Yuan Na was stunned, and Zhao Yuan looked angry.

    "You...why do you say such things? "Zhao Yuan finally spoke, feeling mixed with shame and anger.

    "Then I want to ask you, my parents paid the down payment for the house, and I repaid the loan. If you want me to sell the house, I will sell the house. "

    Li Xihai scolded: "Nima's comparison, it gives you face, doesn't it? "

    “Who do you think you are, asking me to sell my house? "

    "Just because I slept with you? "

    "Your special code is not a virgin either. "

    Being insulted by Li Xihai in front of her best friend, Zhao Yuan could no longer bear it, picked up the coffee and threw it at Li Xihai.

    "Scum! "

    After scolding, Zhao Yuan picked up her bag and left angrily.

    "Beast! "

    Yuan Na dropped these words and followed closely behind.

    When the surrounding customers saw this scene, they were secretly observing and talking in low voices.

    Li Xihai touched the coffee on his face and his cell phone rang.

    "Let's break up. "
title_en: Chapter 1 You want me to sell my house and embed it with diamonds?
